Hi {leaderName},

{memberName} joined your club "{clubName}".

You can review the roster on the club page.

If you don't know this person, or the name doesn't look like a real full name, please tell an IFPA admin: log in, open your profile, choose Edit Profile, use the "Contact IFPA admin" link and choose the topic Other. Reports like this are how IFPA catches fake accounts.

-- IFPA platform
